zoe: Quick update: deployed the compact-kernel switcher canary. Short seq p50 improved ~20%, avg token cost down ~9% on our internal mix. No p99 regressions in 4h.
linh: Nice! Any runtime flags or config changes needed?
zoe: It's controlled by runtime.kernels.compact_switch = true. Canary is 4% hosted pods in us-west and eu-west. Dedicated is opt-in only.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary r-2026-11-compact-switch created. monitors: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/r-2026-11-compact-switch
perf-bot: perf-bot: 4h auto-report: p50 -19.8%, p90 -6.1%, p99 +0.0%. Est cost delta per 1M tokens: -9.2%.
linh: Can ops add a dashboard tile for this canary?
zoe: Yep, already added. Dash: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/compact-switch-canary
linh: Cool. I'll add a note to the release changelog and support playbook.
